name: Chad V. Johnson
role: Licensed psychologist · Associate Professor, University of Oklahoma
bio: Licensed psychologist in Tulsa with more than 25 years of experience in psychotherapy, consultation, training, research, and teaching. He is an Associate Professor in the University of Oklahoma’s Clinical Mental Health Counseling program and a Clinical Assistant Professor of Psychiatry at the OU College of Medicine, where his research focuses on spirituality, psychedelic integration, and advocacy. He holds certificates in psychedelic-assisted therapy and research (CIIS), psychedelic science and medicine (Johns Hopkins), and ketamine-assisted psychotherapy, and is a co-founder of the Oklahoma Psychedelic Collective.

name: Christine “Mooncat” Ziemer
role: Professor of Psychology, Missouri Western State University
bio: Dr. Ziemer is a tenured professor of psychology at Missouri Western State University, where they developed original courses in transpersonal psychology and psychedelic science. They founded the Psychedelic Educators Network, a global network of professors and instructors who teach university courses on psychedelics across many fields. They volunteer with the Zendo Project, Fireside Project, and Safe Journeys Sanctum to provide psychedelic peer support, and co-founded the Kansas City Psychedelic Integration Circle and the Psychedelic Society of Kansas City. They also serve on the board of the Heartland Transpersonal Alliance and as a faculty member of Midwest Psychedelic.
